narr: A stalled frontal boundary became the focus of a line of strong to severe thunderstorms across the area. This line was long-lived and produced dozens of reports of wind damage, flash flooding and even multiple house fires caused by lightning.
ev: Broadcast media reported impassable roads due to heavy rain in a 5 block area of Nicholson near Picayune.
lsr: BROADCAST MEDIA REPORTS ROADS ARE IMPASSABLE IN A 5 BLOCK AREA AROUND NICHOLSON NEAR PICAYUNE, MS.
